newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-BATH NAME ROBINSON AS NEW COACH.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-BATH NAME ROBINSON AS NEW COACH.

text.p: English champions Bath appointed former international flanker Andy Robinson as their new coach on Monday following the resignation of Brian Ashton.
Ashton played a central role in encouraging Bath to adopt a more adventurous brand of rugby and shared in four league triumphs and three Cup successes during his seven years at the club.
He quit his job as a schoolteacher to take on a full-time coaching role, but took paid leave before Christmas amid reports of disagreements involving team manager John Hall.

Bath and England captain Phil de Glanville said he regretted the news of Ashton's resignation, but supported the appointment of Robinson, 32, who won eight England caps and toured Australia with the British Lions in 1989.
